milestones.title: v0.1.0 — the router idea ships
milestones.detail: Deterministic tasks, tier routing, cost guard. Zero capability measurements.

milestones.title: PRs #1–5 — the instrument gets built
milestones.detail: Harness, one attempt path, site, contribution pipeline, driver control set. Still zero measured capability cells.

milestones.title: PR #6 — first measured data ever
milestones.detail: 70 graded disposition cells (control set). Disposition, not capability: flat across effort.

milestones.title: PRs #18–24 — tier-uplift: hidden grading is born
milestones.detail: Cheap+harness reaches the tier above; visible/hidden daylight becomes the design; the 'taste residue' correction (#24) sets the honesty bar.

milestones.title: PRs #25–31 — the harness is packaged public
milestones.detail: capability_harness, findings page, sealed lens shard.

milestones.title: PRs #32–37 — the breadth program + the catch
milestones.detail: Self-run runbook, adaptive gate, and #37: visible graders are gameable — 'cleared everything' was the answer key. The ruler gets honest.

milestones.title: PR #43 — LESSONS + first (provisional) corner
milestones.detail: K=1 layer: 3 cells cleared-once. Below the settled bar by its own admission.

milestones.title: PR #42 — the K=3 floor is sealed
milestones.detail: 5 hidden-graded cells settled; the tier ladder falls (haiku clears T0–T4); first model separation: sonnet-5@low clears the crack haiku can't. $4.31 total frontier spend.

milestones.title: PR #45 — waterline becomes the product
milestones.detail: Measured routing registry + zero-spend CLI + CI durability. Ask it: settled routes cheap, residue is named and priced, missing says missing.

milestones.title: PR #46 — the data reaches the public surfaces
milestones.detail: 51 ledger rows flow through the community pipeline into the comparer/aggregate/cheatsheet; this progress record ships.
